title: Attribute ledger turns to the nearest PR reference across multi-day tasks
body:
Outcome: krn ledger attributes each turn to the PR whose reference is nearest (not the slice ending first), and counts task-id references across all sessions of a multi-day task, so nested slices (#474 inside #472/#473, #468 inside #469) and multi-session tasks (#454, t-wm22s14) are priced.
Why: #486 added a 6 h task-id window before PR open, which drops earlier sessions of multi-day tasks; .krn/runs/ledger-coverage/proof.md lists #474 and #468 as unpriced because their slices nest inside earlier-ending ones.
Proof: ledger on the last 30 PRs prices 30 of 30, and #454's multi-session turns are counted; record under .krn/runs/.
Scope: this repository.
